requirements.question: MANDATORY: Where will our data be stored? Confirm whether data can be kept within the European Union.
requirements.answer: Yes, data can be kept within the European Union. Customer data can be hosted entirely within the EU in our AWS Frankfurt region (eu-central-1), and data, backups and logs remain in the EU. We are hosted on AWS, where customers choose a US region (us-east-1) or an EU region (eu-central-1, Frankfurt), with customer data staying in the chosen region.

requirements.question: Describe your backup and disaster-recovery arrangements, including RPO and RTO.
requirements.answer: Customer data is backed up daily, and backups are encrypted and retained for 35 days, with a copy stored in a second region within the same geography. Our disaster-recovery objectives are a recovery point objective (RPO) of 1 hour and a recovery time objective (RTO) of 4 hours; the plan is tested annually.

requirements.question: Describe your implementation approach and a typical timeline. (Maximum 120 words)
requirements.answer: A typical implementation takes 6 to 8 weeks and is led by a dedicated Larkspur implementation manager.
